runtimeDeliveryMeasurement.loadingSemantics: published hints are per-level lazy; stress corpora are fetched only after the signed-in admin Dev-Mode corpus switcher selects them, but all three provenance-rich trees are copied into every dist

firestoreSerializedSamples.basis: JSON.stringify(Hint) sizes from five provenance-rich real files; excludes Firestore document/field encoding overhead
firestoreSerializedSamples.implication: capacity cannot be safely expressed as a fixed path count; provenance-rich Hint size varies by orders of magnitude. Measure encoded Firestore document bytes and enforce a byte-aware surfaced failure policy.

historicalMissingnessComparison.finding: Historical unknown capability context has not merely remained ambiguous: read-normalize-write cycles can persist upgradeProvenanceEntry()'s synthesized false values. Current raw storage therefore cannot use explicit false as proof that old observations recorded false unless source generation/ingress proves it.
historicalMissingnessComparison.mechanism: level-data-io reads provenance through upgradeProvenanceEntry(); that adapter fills absent usedExistingHints/hintGuided/isolatedTechnique with false; a later canonical hint-file write serializes the expanded hintRecords and can materialize those synthesized values.
historicalMissingnessComparison.correctionRule: Treat historical source-generation absence as unknown at semantic ingress even if a later storage rewrite materialized false. Do not infer original false from current physical presence alone. Future write paths must preserve an explicit semantic unknown state rather than laundering it into a default.

migrationSyntheticFoundAt.interpretation: The cohort is stable back to the September 11 raw store and confined to the legacy stress-1 migration population. Use migration/source-shape membership plus the timestamp cluster as the compatibility predicate; timestamp alone is not a universal rule.
migrationSyntheticFoundAt.correctionTarget: semantic compatibility adapter exposes foundAt as historically unknown for the proven migration-synthetic cohort; do not invent discovery times. A later reversible physical migration may encode that unknown explicitly.

firestoreSizing.measurementKind: UTF-8 JSON payload proxy/lower bound, before Firestore field/index overhead and other levelData fields
firestoreSizing.finding: Path-count caps are not a capacity contract. At current provenance density the median published corpus hint array proxy already exceeds 1 MiB before level metadata/Firestore overhead, while one-event supplemental documents remain small. A full-Hint-per-path Firestore document can also grow dangerously large as provenance accumulates.
firestoreSizing.capacityTarget: preflight actual encoded document size and surface overflow explicitly. Prefer a layout whose growth unit is bounded (semantic-event/occurrence child documents or another sharded representation) over silently truncating paths/events. Exact Firestore SDK/emulator wire-size validation should accompany implementation, but the current five/1000/5000 count policies are already disproven as semantically principled limits.
